title: app_icons: umbrella glyph for the Umbrella? app
objective: ~/src/umbrella ships a family-style launcher icon (charcoal field, shared #B8862E accent, umbrella glyph) generated by the shared generator.
acceptance_criteria: `python3 -m python_pkg.app_icons generate --app umbrella --android` writes the assets and mipmaps with no safe-box warning.
The preview sheet shows the umbrella legibly at 48dp.
apps.py stays under 250 lines and `from python_pkg.app_icons.apps import AppIcon` keeps working.
out_of_scope: Any other app's glyph or the family style.
verifier: generate + preview run and inspected; pytest python_pkg/app_icons 44 passed; pre-commit on the changed files.
